mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS conversation_id, c.user1_id AS user1_id, c.user2_id AS user2_id, c.type AS conversation_type, c.last_message_id AS last_message_id, c.created_at AS created_at, c.updated_at AS updated_at, CASE WHEN c.user1_id = #{userId} THEN c.user2_id ELSE c.user1_id END AS peer_id, u.nickname AS peer_nickname, u.avatar AS peer_avatar, m.content AS last_content, m.type AS last_type, m.created_at AS last_message_created_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages msg WHERE msg.conversation_id = c.id AND msg.sender_id != #{userId} AND msg.is_read = 0 ) AS unread_count FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = CASE WHEN c.user1_id = #{userId} THEN c.user2_id ELSE c.user1_id END LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.id = c.last_message_id WHERE c.user1_id = #{userId} OR c.user2_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
